desc: claimkeeper treats a repo's .claims folder as untrusted: it never reads or writes outside the project (no absolute paths, .. or links leading out), never tracks the store or .git, keeps claim text single-line so it cannot impersonate claimkeeper, and never lets a config remove the built-in secret exclusions.

mentions.anchor: A repo you clone or pull can ship its own `.claims/` folder, so claimkeeper treats the store as untrusted input:
Anything else is reported as `unsafe_path` and never read or written.
A project config can add exclusions, never remove the built-in ones
Store files can come from an untrusted repo, so every path is contained:
configs (possibly from an untrusted repo) can add exclusions, never remove the built-in ones
Store text can come from an untrusted repo and is shown to the agent: keep it on one line,
